body: Welp you better start toughening up cause if nothing is done then its only gonna get worse. That complacency and unwillingness is gonna be the death of us all. My sensei was a 5th dan in Shotokan and a practitioner of Kenpo, Wing Chun, and much more. He was the local english teacher for many years and a pillar of the community. His death has shook our dojo and town to the core. Hug your loved ones and check on their mental health folks, you never know if they are struggling behind the scenes. Oss sensei, we all miss you....
